T1055.name: Process Injection
T1055.description: Adversaries may inject code into processes in order to evade process-based defenses and potentially elevate privileges. Process injection executes arbitrary code in the address space of a separate live process.

T1055.011.name: Extra Window Memory Injection
T1055.011.description: Adversaries may inject into extra window memory regions to evade process-based defenses.

T1486.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
T1486.description: Adversaries may encrypt data on target systems to interrupt availability of system and network resources and prevent recovery without a decryption key.

T1086.name: PowerShell
T1086.description: This technique has been deprecated and superseded by more specific script execution techniques.
